newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Japan Power gets lukewarm response.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Japan Power gets lukewarm response.

text.p: Pakistan's Japan Power Generation Ltd (JPGL) got a lukewarm response at the Karachi bourse on Wednesday ahead of a share offer to help finance a 135.6-megawatt power plant, dealers said.
Japan Power's 10-rupee shares were quoted at 9.90 rupees ($0.26) in kerb trade a day after it published its prospectus for the share issue, dealer Yasin Lakhani said.

Japan Power shares were seen easing in the short term because of generally depressed sentiment due to political uncertainty and Pakistan's economic difficulties. "There are sellers around 9.75 rupees," broker Majid Chapra said.
But Lakhani said the stock could rise on foreign interest later this year and earnings were expected to be good.
"Our preliminary analysis of the company indicates that there is at least 40 percent upside in this share at the 10 rupees level," said Aliya Ehmar, an analyst at ING Barings Securities.
She cited Japan Power's 22-year power purchase agreement with the state-owned Water and Power Development Authority.
The stock will be formally listed on Pakistan's three bourses in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad later this year.
Japan Power has offered shares worth 138 million rupees ($3.72 million) for public subscription on October 23.
It had already placed shares worth 525 million rupees with at least 22 overseas investors and shares worth 135 million rupees with domestic investors, a Japan Power executive said.

The latest share issue is to help finance construction of a 135.6-MW plant at Raiwind near Lahore due to start power generation by October 1997. Mitsubishi Heavy Industries will make the generators, to be supplied by Toyota Tsusho Corp.
Toyota Tsusho Singapore (Pvt) Ltd is providing supplier credits for the equipment, while Siemens AG will be responsible for construction.

Overseas investors include Toyota Tsusho Corp of Japan, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Bankers Trust New York Corp, Somers Nominees (Far East) Ltd of Hong Kong and Fledging Nominees International Ltd of Hong Kong.
